properties.DESCRIPTION: Gulf of America - Hazardous Space Operations --- On November 13, 2026, between 2245Z and 0040Z, on November 14, 2026, rocket launching operations are scheduled to take place near Boca Chica, TX. For additional information regarding the launch, mariners can contact the U.S. Coast Guard Sector Corpus Christi Command Center at (800) 874-2143 or access: www.navcen.uscg.gov/msi

properties.TITLE: Sector Corpus Christi, Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) - Sector Corpus Christi, Territorial Sea/Space Operations/Safety Zone/Commercial (Safety)
properties.DESCRIPTION: Gulf of America – Safety Zone – Space Launch --- From: 2026-11-13 To: 2026-11-19 --- The U.S. Coast Guard Captain of the Port Corpus Christi is establishing a Safety Zone in the near shore region of the space launch hazard area in the Gulf of America.  The Safety Zone will be active on November 13, 2026, from 2:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m., local time.  Back-up dates include November 14 - November 19, 2026, from 2:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m., each day.  The Safety Zone consists of all navigable waters of the Gulf of America, from the surface to bottom, and is bound by the following positions: 26-02-36N 097-09-08W, 26-03-00N 097-07-00W, 26-07-48.0N 096-56-02.2W, then following the 12 nautical mile Territorial Sea Line to the United States of America/Mexico Maritime Boundary Line, following the United States of America/Mexico Maritime Boundary Line to position 25-57-24.2N 097-08-49.0W, and following the coast back to 26-02-36N 097-09-08W.  All vessels are prohibited from entering the Safety Zone, unless granted permission by the U.S. Coast Guard.  Mariners with urgent concerns can contact the U.S. Coast Guard Sector Corpus Christi Command Center at (800) 874-2143.

properties.WATERWAY_NAME: Sector Corpus Christi, Submerged Land Act (SLA)
properties.DESCRIPTION: South Bay – Safety Zone – Space Launch --- From: 2026-11-13 To: 2026-11-20 --- The U.S. Coast Guard Captain of the Port Corpus Christi is establishing a Safety Zone in South Bay.  The Safety Zone will be active for the Starship Flight 15 launch on November 13, 2026, from 2:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m., local time.  Back-up dates include November 14 - November 19, 2026, from 2:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m., each day.  The reentry and landing of Starship Flight 15 will take place approximately 22.5 hours after the initial launch.  The Safety Zone will be activated again for the Starship Flight 15 reentry/landing operation on November 14, 2026, from 1:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m.  Back-up dates include November 15 – 20, 2026, from 1:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m.  The Safety Zone consists of all navigable waters of South Bay, from the surface to bottom, and is bound by the following positions: 26-02-45.0N 097-11-06.3W, 26-02-45.0N 097-10-53.4W, and following the South Bay internal coastline to the point of origin.  All vessels are prohibited from entering the Safety Zone, unless granted permission by the U.S. Coast Guard.  Mariners should monitor all marine radio broadcasts and avoid the area during the specified launch and reentry times.  Mariners with urgent concerns can contact the U.S. Coast Guard Sector Corpus Christi Command Center at (800) 874-2143.

The reentry and landing of Starship Flight 15 will take place approximately 22.5 hours after the initial launch.  The Safety Zone will be active for the reentry and landing on November 14, 2026, from 1:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m., local time.
